name: Shell Horn

pages.text: Maze Captain loot. Use near water inside the Ice Maze to summon Cornelia.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Defeat a Maze Captain: its native loot table contains a Shell Horn. Look while exploring the Ice Maze and pirate ships.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Hold and use the horn near suitable water. The current configuration requires the Ice Maze. A valid summon location consumes one horn. Unsuitable terrain causes failure, but still applies the cooldown.

pages.title: Combat and loot
pages.text: After summoning on a dedicated server, confirm Start. Prepare healing, breathing and Weakness for the emergency recovery. $(l:handbook/bosses/aquamirae/captain_cornelia)Cornelia’s ghost$(/l).
